text_matches.fragment:
- An instance with `N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=false` reads every PostHog flag as disabled. Self-hosted users can still enable your change with `N8N_FEATURE_FLAG_OVERRIDES`.
- A PostHog flag also reaches self-hosted instances. To limit it to n8n Cloud, add a condition on `n8n_deployment_type` in PostHog.

- Add [metrics](../observability.md#metrics-logs-traces) for what your change does, and [telemetry events](../observability.md#telemetry) if appropriate.
- Label your metrics by whether the flag is enabled.
- Build a [Grafana](https://grafmon.app.n8n.cloud/) dashboard that compares instances with and without the flag, on the same n8n versions.

text_matches.fragment:
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED` | boolean | `true` | When set to `false`, Instance AI tracing is disabled. |
| `LANGSMITH_API_KEY` / `LANGCHAIN_API_KEY` | string | unset | Enables direct LangSmith export for local and self-hosted setups. |

| `N8N_INSTANCE_AI_WORKFLOW_SUGGESTIONS_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | Enable workflow suggestions, internal self-healing investigations, and result review routes. Restart n8n after changing this setting. Investigations require a backend caller. This does not add automatic triggers. |
| `N8N_INSTANCE_AI_NODE_CONTEXT_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | Force-enable canvas node context. `false` falls back to the PostHog flag. |
| `N8N_INSTANCE_AI_FOLDER_EXPLORATION_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | Force-enable folder exploration (folder attribution and folder scoping on `list_workflows`). `false` falls back to the PostHog flag. |
